title: Escalation rules
info: When a rule's conditions match during an AI conversation, the AI stops at the next step and escalates the contact to the rule's pool. A rule is measured in dry-run and shadow before it acts.
restricted: You need config.rules to see escalation rules.
readOnly: Read-only: editing requires config.rules with read and write.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.desc: Create a rule in draft, then take it through dry-run and shadow before activating it.

cond.window: (average of {{n}} turns — not evaluated; edit the rule)

card.lockedHint: Only draft or disabled rules can be edited or deleted. Disable it first.

confirm.delete: Delete rule "{{name}}"? Past triggers stay in the log.

form.idTaken: There is already a rule with this id.
form.name: Name
form.conditionsHint: Sentiment is the MEASURED one, from the customer's message in flows that name it (customer_utterance); the rule re-evaluates when the measurement arrives. Unmeasured sentiment never matches.
form.targetPoolHint: Without a pool the rule is evaluated but never acts.
form.priorityHint: 1 to 10; the highest matching rule wins.
form.noticeHint: Sent as-is when the rule transfers the customer. {{n}} characters left.
